integrity: Proved from circulant block spectra, elementary global inequalities for t>=1, uniform Gaussian-tail controls and implicit expansion. Numerical checks are not used as infinite proofs. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact positive-definiteness characterization is established only for bandwidth t>=1 and n>=20; the all-positive-bandwidth statement is a last-failure supremum, not an assertion excluding smaller disjoint admissible intervals. Finite-size asymptotics are proved with analytic error terms; quoted decimals and finite tests are illustrative. Equivalent older circulant covariance results might exist.
title: Parity-split Gaussian bandwidth on circular ladders
